verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs list "file transfer in both directions" as a core session capability, and the GitHub repo documents a file copy-and-paste implementation for Windows, Linux and macOS, so the product itself delivers in-session file transfer between host and viewer. A community report that clipboard file copy-paste from Linux to Windows doesn't work affects only one transfer path on one platform pair, not the core feature. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the transfer workflow (UI, limits, resume, mobile/web support), independent hands-on confirmation that the dedicated file-transfer feature works, and resolution of the reported Linux-to-Windows clipboard file-paste failure.

support.subject: As a power user, I can transfer files between the host and the viewing device inside a session

citations.quote: libs/clipboard: file copy and paste implementation for Windows, Linux, macOS.
